factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Partly sourced. NOAA/NEFSC habitat material reports adult occurrence from about 0.6–23°C and preferred adult habitat around 12–15°C; NOAA describes winter flounder as cold-water adapted and most common north of Delaware Bay. The configured range overlaps occurrence, but the 6–15°C ideal interval extends below the reported adult preference and is not locally calibrated.
